text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide and I have just<n>finished our training
session for the<n>day.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Hm? Where's my bottle? Did I leave<n>it on the
track?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, Trainer. I need to get my bottle.<n>I'll head
straight home afterward.
choice_data_list: It's dark already, so I'll go with you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Really? Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I'm pretty sure it was around there...

text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Did you not hear us the first time? We<n>have a race
coming up soon so get<n>out of our way and scram.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Excuse you? I'm in your way?That's strange because I'm prettysure I was here first.

text_block_list.name: Sharp-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
What does that matter to us?<n>Seriously, get lost
already!

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Oh, now you're asking for it!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Looks like it... I'm going to see<n>what's wrong.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Excuse me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I was under the impression that there<n>were no
restrictions on the use of this<n>track today.

text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Great, another nosy meddler. What do<n>you want?

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Hayahide?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to understand if special<n>permission is
required to use this<n>track today for some reason.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If so, please let me know who I need<n>to speak to in
order to get permission.<n>I can go to them on
Taishin's behalf.

text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Well, uh... It's not exactly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Apologies, I couldn't quite hear you.It's not exactly what? Are you sayingthat special permission is not requiredto use this track?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
In that case, would you care to<n>explain why you told
Taishin to<n>leave? Did she commit some sort of
infraction, perhaps?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If she interfered with your training in<n>any way,
please let me know.

text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
What's the matter? Can it be that you<n>had no
legitimate reason to harass<n>Taishin and simply
wanted to throw<n>your weight around?

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then I believe it'syou who is in the wrong.

text_block_list.name: Assertive Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ngh! Okay, we get it already!

text_block_list.name: Sharp-eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text: This is so stupid! Let's just get out<n>of here!

The two are no match for Biwa<n>Hayahide's cold,
hard logic and run<n>off without another word.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Honestly, the audacity! Acting like<n>they're the only
ones allowed on the<n>track...

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: ...Sorry. You didn't need to do that for<n>me.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's fine. I don't mind.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Try not to stay out too late, okay? And<n>make sure to
eat something once you<n>get back to the dorm.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah, I know.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hehe, good!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: That was so awesome of you!
Your logical thinking and reasoning got them good!
Your logical argument and reasoning got them good!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Sorry to keep you waiting, Trainer.
choice_data_list: That was so awesome of you!
Your logical thinking and reasoning got them good!
Your logical argument and reasoning got them good!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: R-really? I was just being my usual<n>self, honestly...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: I will say one thing, though.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
The best way to handle overly<n>emotional arguments
is to strike them<n>down with sound logic.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Doing so usually trips up the other<n>person so much,
they give up on their<n>own.

Biwa Hayahide is a little prouder of<n>her logical
approach to things than<n>usual today.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I didn't expect it to have come in<n>handy in such a
situation.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I know sometimes I can come off as<n>cold and
inflexible because of my<n>overly logical thinking,
but...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
If I can use it to help my friends out,<n>then I think it's
safe to call it a<n>strength. Hehe.

After successfully defending a friend,<n>Biwa
Hayahide seems to feel even<n>more confident in her
reasoning<n>abilities.
